Name: LOT_RESULT_SMALLBASE_AND_SPOT_ST
Description: Sites placed in each map pattern, from the offline pattern lottery: attach point, site map, copy and variation, and the modifier the site adds.

Fields.Name: Disable Param - Network Test
Fields.Description: Set: the row is left out of the network test build. Retail: set on 4 rows.

Fields.Name: Pattern ID
Fields.Description: Map pattern this site belongs to.

Fields.Name: Attach Point ID
Fields.Description: SmallBaseAndSpotAttachPoint row where the site is placed. The row is skipped if the attach point does not exist.

Fields.Name: Small Map ID
Fields.Description: SmallBaseMapVariationParam row of the map placed there (3810 = map m38_10).

Fields.Name: Map Index
Fields.Description: Copy number of this map within the pattern: 0 for the first site that uses the map, 1 for the second, and so on.

Fields.Name: Variation ID
Fields.Description: Variation of the map (0-9), the slot of SmallBaseMapVariationParam Variation Value / Variation Icon ID 1-10 minus one. It also picks the variation icon shown on the site's map pin.

Fields.Name: Unknown
Fields.Description: Appears unused by the game: the function that reads this param's other fields does not read it. Retail 0 on every row.

Fields.Name: Modifier
Fields.Description: Modifier the site adds to the pattern's active modifiers (e.g. 424, 14000). 0: none. Retail: equals the map's SmallBaseMapVariationParam Modifier 3 on 23,791 of 23,797 rows.
